title: NSW Steering Committee Holds First Meeting
author: NSW Team
excerpt: The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee of the National Single Window held its inaugural meeting, establishing the governance framework and strategic priorities.
content: The National Single Window (NSW) project Steering Committee held its inaugural meeting on February 28, 2025. The meeting brought together senior representatives from the Ministry of Economy and Innovation, NAIS/AKSHI, the General Directorate of Customs, and other cross-border regulatory agencies.

During the meeting, committee members approved the project governance framework, defining the roles and responsibilities of each participating institution. It was decided that NAIS/AKSHI will serve as the primary operator of the NSW system, while the Ministry of Economy and Innovation will exercise strategic oversight of the project.

The committee reviewed and approved the 2025 work plan, which includes the completion of business process analysis, the drafting of the technical architecture, and the commencement of the software development phase. Special priority was given to harmonizing the legal framework with EU requirements in the context of the accession process.

A significant decision of the meeting was the establishment of three technical working groups: the Information Technology Group, the Business Processes Group, and the Legal Framework Group. These groups will report regularly to the Steering Committee and will ensure the implementation of strategic decisions.
The next Steering Committee meeting was scheduled for the second quarter of 2025, where progress achieved will be reviewed and decisions will be taken regarding the technical development phase.
